feed.title: AI Rebuilds: new on the list
feed.subtitle: Software and games rebuilt by AI agents and clean-room teams, as they are added to the list.

entry.title: Redox OS: rebuilds A Unix-like operating system
entry.content:
Rebuilds A Unix-like operating system. A microkernel operating system written from scratch in Rust, with its own C library so that Unix and Linux programs can be ported to it. The project does not accept contributions generated by LLMs.

No AI, Reimplementation, 2015, Jeremy Soller and contributors

Website · Source

entry.title: solidcore: rebuilds NVIDIA SMLib, a CAD solid-modelling kernel
entry.content:
Rebuilds NVIDIA SMLib, a CAD solid-modelling kernel. A safe-Rust port of the open-source SMLib B-rep kernel that now runs SolidCraft. Many coding agents work on it in parallel under a shared AGENTS.md rulebook, and it has since moved away from the original design. Experimental.

AI-built, Port, 2026, Tangency Labs

Website · Source

entry.title: pgrust: rebuilds PostgreSQL
entry.content:
Rebuilds PostgreSQL. A Rust reimplementation of Postgres that speaks its wire protocol and SQL dialect, with a new JIT-compiled query engine. Its author built it by directing coding agents, mainly Codex. Still in beta.

AI-built, Reimplementation, 2026, Michael Malis
